note: The BA's Health Intake Routing document, 'Revised Intake Routing' tab: Part 1's routing rules and Deborah's decisions 1-45, Part 2's questions by body and age, and Part 3's appendix (answer types, 'Shown when', 'When asked'). Choices for and wording of questions the document leaves open are recorded in docs/decisions/phase-4-routing-doc.md. The privacy notice is still a placeholder until the attorney's wording is in. The rule language is described in app/health/bank.py.
